messages:
Maya: Heads-up — PR evals started failing intermittently on GHA PR gate for the new quantization suite. Failing during checkout on self-hosted runners, message is 'runner busy' or 'job aborted'.
Raj: Ugh. Can you paste the runner logs / run link? Which PR?
Maya: PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/412 - here's the job URL from gha-bot: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/1234567890 
gha-bot: Job log excerpt: 
```
2026-02-15T09:12:03Z [runner] INFO starting self-hosted runner
2026-02-15T09:12:09Z [runner] INFO registered with scale-group=gha-eval-ssd
2026-02-15T09:12:40Z [runner] WARN heartbeat missed, deregistering
2026-02-15T09:12:41Z [controller] ERROR job dispatch failed: no active runners
```
Omar: Looks like the autoscaler starts a runner but it times out before the controller binds the job. Probably a provisioning race where runner instance is still initializing. We saw similar with the nightly eval backfill.
Nina: That heartbeat window is 30s in the current autoscaler config — too tight for GPU init + model cache warmup. I can bump to 90s and add a probe to only mark runner ready after agent bootstrap. Patch suggestion: 
```
# infra/autoscaler/gha-selfhosted.yaml
spec:
  runnerHeartbeatSeconds: 90
  readinessProbe:
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 5
    successCondition: 'agent.ok == true'
```
Maya: Nice. Short-term workaround: route PR evals to our Buildkite smoke pool when matrix=small to avoid the heavy quant matrix until infra patch lands. I added a conditional in the workflow: 
```
if: matrix.size == 'small' && github.event.pull_request != null
  uses: redwood-inference/buildkite-runner@v1
```
Raj: We should also add a tiny early-exit smoke test that runs a single short eval (1 prompt) to catch obvious regressions before queuing the full matrix. Saves capacity and gives faster feedback.
Maya: Agreed — added smoke job in the PR: run-smoke-eval (10s timeout). If it fails we mark PR gate failed and don't spawn matrix. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/412/files 
Omar: I'll coordinate with infra to roll the heartbeat change to staging tonight. I'll also add a temporary host-tag rule so GHA prefers pre-warmed hosts for quant jobs: tag=prewarmed-quant.
sre-oncall: I'll monitor the GHA queue and alert on >5 min queue time for PR gates. Pager rule created: evals_gha_queue_exceeded.
devx-runner-bot: deploy started for infra/autoscaler@staging (deploy-20260215-21). :eyes:
Maya: Thanks all. Once infra change is live we'll revert the Buildkite fallback. Leaving the smoke test in place. :shipit:
Raj: Nice triage — can we add a short note to eng-ml runbook about this race and the heartbeat knob? I'll update the docs.
Nina: Yep — adding runbook entry and the YAML snippet now.
Maya: Closing loop — after staging deploy we ran three PR evals back-to-back, no runner-deregister seen. Will monitor for 24h and then roll to prod.
